skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Invisible Dirge
skins.content: EPOQUE Collection New Arrivals/Invisible Dirge. Taking the model's peculiar traits in consideration, this outfit was completed without being tailored. Combines comfort, fashion, and a proper fit while also protecting the operator's vitals.
skins.quote: With a light touch of her tail, courage, fear, and shyness become things of the past, along with life itself.

skins.name: Under A Veil
skins.content: EPOQUE Sub-Brand [Passe] Series Selects/Under A Veil. Manticore once wore it on a mission in Sargon, and was bothered by the clanging of the gold accessories as she moved.
skins.quote: The stinger of Sargon reflects no moonlight. Wrapped in darkness, she only shows herself only when the outcome is no longer in doubt.
